adr: Warden PRD 0001 and draft ADRs 0001-0012, owner-reviewed 2026-11-17
status: Proposed delivery ownership; planning coverage is not implementation proof

decisions.title: Prove durable admission, serialization, recovery, ownership races and cross-host stop controls
Pin OpenCode and prove effective restrictions, local routing, cancellation and real isolation
Prove compiler-backed lookup and supported SDK feasibility; identify a viable comparison candidate
One repository per instance with separate mutable state and authority on shared hosts
Two versioned YAML schemas, canonical setting homes, explicit defaults and combined validation
Closed built-ins, operator ceiling, deny/human precedence and no self-authorizing policy or task code
Typed semantic states, facets, blockers, leases, ownership, links and review/evidence/operation identities
One authoritative comment per item, projected labels, durable intents/journal and shared serialized Actions effects
Bounded automatic scoped App credential lifecycle, protected roots, opt-out and honest recovery
Global/instance stop, cancellation, explicit resume, unknown-control denial and uncertain-effect recovery
Authorized GitHub-native decisions persisted before effect; revision-bound 24-hour action approvals and durable design approval
Protected/redacted state with actual durability checks and transcript/audit/decision retention separated from first write
Operator can run warden setup without overwriting config, adopting backlog or enabling live AI
Operator can run warden config validate for effective constraints and actionable errors
Operator can run warden status without inference, including pending work, recovery and freshness
Operator can run warden stop and distinguish local cancellation from confirmed shared stop
Operator can run warden resume without launching AI or resetting authority/counters
Deterministic metadata/template/rule routing without semantic duplicate decisions or review markers
Immediate eligible claims, accountable assignee, confirmed assignment and conflict-safe ownership
48-hour initial/substantive-fix obligations, timely delivery assessment, approved extensions and frozen unexpired holds
48/72-hour nudges, five-day silence, 14/28-day reporter clocks, exemptions and explained takeover eligibility
Default-disabled new/converted drafts, optional exemptions and deliberate existing-draft adoption
Explicit inventory/selection, preserved ownership/commitments and nonretroactive notice-based clocks
Configurable App-attributed voice distinguishes automated and AI output without impersonation or hardcoded vendor
Reconcile source timestamps and outside GitHub changes without reopening closed work or treating stop as an extension
Operator/event handlers can invoke deterministic Intake through the shared writer
Contributors can volunteer through the registered claim handler and see confirmed assignment or conflict
Scheduled Actions and the CLI can invoke Sweep while the Mac/model are offline
Operator can inventory and explicitly adopt selected backlog separately from setup
decisions.source: PRD 6,10; proposed command spelling in plan P2

decisions.title: Thin AgentRunner with fixed inputs/tools, Ajv-revalidated structured output and deterministic semantic validation
Actual resolved local provider/model and permissions enforced, with no silent remote fallback
Manual bounded snapshot scans, fresh serial sessions, persistent retry/resource limits, checkpoint/report/exit
Explicit urgency/finish-work priority with age/capacity fairness, preserved blocked age and no feature starvation
Evidence-backed bugs, separate facets and approved feature/enhancement design with uncertainty/wontfix escalation
Read-only precise findings, accepted review identity, delta/material invalidation, unchanged reuse and CI-only gate reevaluation
Independent trusted baseline/candidate evidence, static-first ladder, behavioral checks and control-weakening detection
Compiler-backed definitions/references/impact with verifiable revision/context/freshness and explicit degradation
Measured baseline versus pinned Atlas and SCIP or CodeGraphContext comparison before mandatory graph selection
Actual supported SDK/API/deployment-target enforcement separate from retrieval with unsupported checks visible
Scoped retrieval preserves denials, reasoning and conflicts; evidence-linked reconsideration without authority transfer
Operator can run bounded warden run with task selection and distinguish shadow from global dry-run
Operator can invoke Triage and inspect local shadow proposals and blockers
Operator can invoke Review and inspect precise accepted/current versus stale findings without branch edits
Factory-owned bug/approved-feature implementation with scope recheck, cap, evidence and Merge Danger
Trusted-base takeover evaluates abandoned work as data, preserves issue and credits sound contributions
Factory-only corrections with persistent three-cycle/no-progress/retry accounting and timely contributor-round escalation
Eligible contributor/factory auto-merge checks all current platform/evidence/authority/approval gates and reconciles actual outcome
Independent risk/severity gates, high-risk/authority changes, verified dependency origin and legitimate approval independence
Critical-escape scope pause, evidence/alerting and current-state-aware targeted remediation with reviewed resume
Operator can invoke Implement for bugs and approved features and inspect PR evidence or escalation
Operator can invoke Rework only on factory branches and inspect cycle/verification outcomes
Outbound Gateway approval cards use authorized user IDs, non-sensitive summaries and GitHub-first persistence/fallback
Manual evidence-backed Retro proposals improve design/static/runtime/rules without quotas, training or automatic authority expansion
Scoped export/purge, configurable transcript expiry and separate decision/audit/recovery safeguards
Optional Discord/credential helper stays available without initiating inference
Authorized maintainer can use precise approve/deny buttons without a public ingress or required-review bypass
Operator can invoke warden run --task retro and inspect a justified improvement PR or no-change result
Operator can invoke warden data export with explicit scoped selection and redaction
Operator can invoke warden data purge with explicit scope/confirmation and retention/recovery safeguards
Versioned scoped TypeScript/Node npm/CLI candidate with owned publish identity, schemas, changelog and compatibility
Dry-run schema/config/behavior diff and approved upgrade without silent changes to authority, checks or clocks
Prepared-Mac quickstart, tested prerequisites/recovery and configuration-only adoption with no pilot-specific task code
Operator can install the scoped candidate and reach every promised task and management command
Operator can run warden upgrade --dry-run before an explicitly approved upgrade
Curated 20-PR/20-issue replay, separate 90% agreement, 10 blocking findings and every critical case detected
Final installed-candidate functional/recovery matrix with zero unauthorized effects, duplicate accepted reviews or lost state
Publish tested hardware/runtime/harness/model/compiler/SDK matrix, finite pilot budgets and outcome/wait/resource/lookup metrics
Explicit evidence-reviewed maintainer live authorization, eligible auto-merge default and separately authorized publication
Operator can explicitly enable selected qualified live scope through a distinct setup step and inspect its receipt
decisions.source: PRD 10,11; proposed activation setup surface in plan P7

phases.name: Capability proofs
accepts: Documented proof commands demonstrate a concrete durable inbox and shared writer under queue overflow, crashes, uncertain effects, ownership races and cross-host stop controls.
Pinned OpenCode proves fresh structured sessions, effective restrictions, resolved local routing, cancellation and real containment without home credentials, unrelated files or unrestricted network.
A compiler-backed lookup/SDK feasibility case identifies supported checks and a viable SCIP or CodeGraphContext comparison candidate.

phases.name: Secure walking skeleton
accepts: Separate instances preserve repository-specific state/authority; typed states/facets and two validated versioned YAML schemas enforce canonical homes, explicit defaults, deny/human precedence and approved operator ceilings.
User can run warden setup, warden config validate and warden run --task intake --dry-run through the real core; setup creates approved missing files/labels only and never adopts or activates.
User can run warden status without a model to inspect deadlines, last sweep, pending/uncertain operations, blockers, credential/stop status and evidence freshness.

User can run warden stop and warden resume with local-versus-confirmed-remote acknowledgements, cancellation, fail-closed unknown controls, preserved counters and no implicit inference; shared writer operating modes enforce global dry-run against all sources and queued effects.
The proven inbox, journal and serialized Actions writer persist/reconcile all effects and projections without a competing ledger or local write fallback.
Scoped App credentials renew/rotate/recover automatically with bounded redacted audit, opt-out and no broader-PAT or revocation bypass; roots/write tokens stay outside workers.

The GitHub-native authorized decision handler records approvals/denials before action, enforces 24-hour revision/policy/evidence-bound action expiry and durable design approval, and protects/redacts retained state from first write.

phases.name: Deterministic housekeeping and adoption
accepts: User can run warden run --task intake, --task claim and --task sweep; registered event/scheduled handlers use the same writer while the Mac/model are offline.
The registered volunteering handler confirms one eligible owner after GitHub assignment; conflicting/unauthorized claims and factory races cannot overwrite ownership.

48-hour delivery/substantive-fix windows, earlier commitments, pre-expiry approved extensions, holds/release and actual timely submission timestamps survive delayed review, CI and stop; placeholder pushes/comments never renew delivery.
Sweep handles separate 48/72-hour nudges, five-day response closure, 14/28-day reporter clocks, exemptions, explained closure/released assignment and retained issue/work references.
Draft policy covers opened and converted drafts with valid claims retained; source-state reconciliation never reopens intentionally closed work and author/CI observations do not start AI.

User can invoke the separately exposed adoption CLI for dry-run inventory and explicit selected-item confirmation; settle proposed warden adopt syntax in the PRD before implementation, preserve ownership and publish nonretroactive notice clocks.

Contributor-facing messages use configured App/voice, distinguish AI assistance from deterministic housekeeping, and do not impersonate a maintainer; optional live housekeeping requires explicit separate authorization.

phases.name: Bounded local Triage and Review
accepts: User can run warden run [--task <name>] [--dry-run], warden run --task triage and warden run --task review through fresh serial pinned OpenCode sessions with no inference daemon; global dry-run confirms writer-wide mutation prohibition including housekeeping/queued effects or reports unconfirmed protection, unlike AI-only shadow.
Ajv and deterministic semantic validation reject malformed/unsafe results; actual local routing/tool permissions are checked each execution and failures preserve work without remote fallback.

Snapshot selection, urgent/finish-work priority, age/capacity fairness, cap-aware deferral and persistent finite item/turn/time/context/resource/retry budgets report and exit without waiting on humans/CI.

Triage returns evidence-backed bug classifications or uncertainty and complete feature/design proposals requiring approval; read-only Review emits precise findings and alone advances accepted markers.
Unchanged reviews are reused, delta/material base/policy/evidence changes revalidate affected conclusions, and CI/approval-only updates perform no inference.

Trusted isolated verification captures baseline/candidate commands, inputs, output and artifacts independently of the model, detects weakening and requires appropriate static versus behavioral evidence.

Compiler-backed lookup provides revision/context/freshness-bound definitions/references; pinned Atlas and SCIP or CodeGraphContext are compared with accuracy/citations/impact/latency/memory/token evidence before graph selection.

Actual SDK/API/deployment-target checks publish supported/unsupported coverage and block missing mandatory evidence; scoped decision retrieval honors denials/conflicts and requires evidence-linked reconsideration.

phases.name: Complete factory and merge loop
accepts: User can run warden run --task implement and warden run --task rework on factory workspaces; bug and approved-feature paths produce independently verified PRs with Merge Danger and no premature review marker.
Factory ownership/cap and approved scope are rechecked; credited trusted-base takeover never edits or blindly executes contributor branches.

Three factory cycles, no-progress completion, separate retry exhaustion and three timely contributor fix rounds persist across cold starts/replacement PRs; third-cycle success completes and unresolved timely work escalates without automatic closure.

Both contributor and factory PRs can merge only with current authorized scope, severity/risk gates, independent evidence, required genuine reviews/checks, expected head and refreshed base/policy/approval/hold/stop context.

Verified automation-origin dependency/CVE fixes remain within authority; high-risk/uncertain/breaking/migration and self-authority changes escalate; an App cannot approve its own PR as an independent identity.
Lost replies, duplicate/stale delivery and already-accepted external effects reconcile without duplicate accepted work; linked issues resolve only for actual satisfied merged scope.

A critical escape pauses affected scope with evidence/alerting and targeted current-state-aware remediation; reviewed explicit resume is required. All integration mutations remain disposable-repository-only.

phases.name: Discord, Retro and data controls
accepts: Authorized maintainers can use Discord approve/deny buttons with explicit user-ID mapping, precise revision/policy/risk/evidence context and non-sensitive summaries via outbound Gateway.
Decisions persist through the GitHub writer before action; stale/duplicate/unauthorized clicks grant nothing and the GitHub-native path remains usable through Discord/helper/model outages.
The optional standalone helper starts without public ingress or model invocation and preserves bounded credential-controller authority.
User can run warden run --task retro to inspect an evidence-backed improvement PR or justified no-change result; history informs proposals but never silently expands authority or trains a model.
User can run warden data export and warden data purge with explicit scoped selection/confirmation, redaction, real durability/error receipts and pending-recovery safeguards.
Transcript expiry defaults to 30 days while decisions remain until explicit removal and configurable security-audit retention stays separate.

phases.name: Release candidate and upgrade path
accepts: User can install the packed scoped npm/TypeScript/Node CLI candidate on a supported prepared Mac and invoke all eight tasks and promised management commands outside the source tree.

Owned scope/availability is confirmed before publication; schemas/orders/changelog and tested prerequisites/recovery/compatibility notes ship without secrets, personal paths or a prototype production dashboard.
User can run warden upgrade --dry-run to inspect schema/config/default/behavior differences; applying an explicit approved upgrade never silently expands authority or weakens checks/clocks.

The quickstart covers setup, separate adoption, shadow/dry-run, independent housekeeping, approvals, stop/resume, recovery and data controls without undocumented steps, and a second repository works by configuration alone.

phases.name: Qualification and explicit activation
accepts: Maintainer-curated replay covers at least 20 PRs and 20 issues, at least 10 blocking findings, separate at-least-90-percent blocking-finding/triage agreement denominators and every curated critical case, with misses reported.
The final installed candidate passes all 15 PRD functional/recovery evidence rows with zero unauthorized effects, duplicate accepted unchanged reviews or lost-state recovery failures.
Published measured finite budgets and hardware/OS/runtime/harness/model/isolation/compiler/SDK matrix accompany status/run-report state/age/wait/outcome/recovery/token/resource/lookup metrics.

User can run the warden setup CLI and explicitly enable selected qualified live scope through a distinct activation step, then inspect its protected receipt in warden status; ordinary setup, repository defaults, replay success and elapsed time cannot activate.

Maintainer reviews the evidence and separately authorizes live scope and any publication/tagging; eligible auto-merge becomes default only inside that authorization, with stop/incident recovery available.
